Package com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.downgrade

Class DowngradeManager

java.lang.Object
com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.downgrade.DowngradeManager
public class DowngradeManager extends Object
Manages version downgrade functionality with backup restoration and signature verification. Allows users to roll back to previous versions with security validation.

Every restorable version lives in its own directory holding the archived JAR (app.jar) and a metadata.properties file describing the version, the backup date and the SHA-256 checksum of the archive.
